rows.grounds: numeral element forming the count eighty-four
locative plural indicating the large number in which something occurs
compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (mechanism/device) in locative plural
past passive participle describing beings subjected to affliction

items.question: Within what vast multitude of womb-mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The count specified is eighty-four thousand.
Beings within these locations are tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across the full expanse of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
